sources.summary: Indian studio AKSH Architects has completed The Earthen Retreat, a cluster of guesthouses in Pune created by repurposing several small abandoned buildings and coating them with mud and lime plaster. The 557-square-metre plot was previously occupied by four site offices and storage units that had outlived their original purpose.
